policy.mapping_basis: test method names and bodies read at the audited commit, matched against contract clause text

clauses.clause: every baseline scene path is under the project root and contains no consumer product name
every required folder is under the project root, uses forward slashes with no trailing slash, is unique, and contains no consumer product name
running the folder scaffold twice reuses every existing folder and creates nothing new the second time
clauses.note: The test drives ProjectFolderScaffold.EnsureDirectories(projectRoot, folders) against a disposable Assets/__FoundationsTests_<guid> root with the contract folders rebased under it, and deletes the root in a finally block. EnsureIndieDirectories() delegates to the same overload with the contract root, so the fixed-root path runs the code under test.

clauses.clause: Validate reports each missing required folder, baseline scene, and activation marker with a stable issue code and marks the folder and marker issues auto-fixable
clauses.note: The test calls IndieProjectValidator.ValidateIndieBaseline(projectRoot) on a disposable empty root and asserts the three codes, one issue per contract folder and scene, AutoFixable on the folder and marker issues, and no AutoFixable on scene issues. The parameterless ValidateIndieBaseline() runs the same directory-contract checks against Assets/_Project before the project-wide rules.

clauses.clause: the Editor and test assembly definitions reference no consumer runtime assembly
clauses.note: validate_foundation_assembly_references in scripts/validate_repository.py rejects any reference under packages/unity/foundations that is not a Lingkyn.* or Unity-owned assembly name (GUID references included); tests/test_repository_contract.py proves the rule fails closed.

clauses.clause: a fresh VrBaselineConfig keeps continuous move disabled and every generated path constant stays under Assets/_Project with no consumer product name
rig repair configures the caster each NearFarInteractor references, raises a shorter cast distance, and never lowers a longer authored value
an interactor without a resolvable far caster produces a failed result whose diagnostic names the interactor
a rig with no interactors succeeds, configures nothing, and claims nothing
every by-name resolution reports through XrBaselineDiagnostics.Unresolved once per key, and the key set can be reset
clauses.note: The test proves the once-per-key helper; the wiring of every Editor call site through it was audited by reading the source at the audited commit and is listed in the xr-baseline changelog.

clauses.clause: Initialize Sandbox resets the key set first and ends with xr_baseline_initialized_with_unresolved when any key was reported
missing: a test that runs XrBaselineMenu.InitializeSandbox in a project without the XRI Starter Assets sample and expects the xr_baseline_initialized_with_unresolved warning; InitializeSandbox opens or creates the real Sandbox scene in NewSceneMode.Single, creates the config and greybox assets under Assets/_Project, and saves to the fixed VrBaselineProjectPaths.SandboxScene, so it needs a root-injectable entry through VrBaselineProjectPaths, VrBaselineConfigAccess, VrBaselineAssetsSetup, VrBaselineScenePlacer, and GenericXrRigFactory before a disposable-scene test can run without touching a real project

clauses.clause: GrabbableHoverVisual warns once per component when XR Interaction Toolkit, XRGrabInteractable, or isHovered cannot be resolved
clauses.note: The test adds GrabbableHoverVisual to an inactive GameObject without XRGrabInteractable and calls the internal TryResolveGrabInteractable seam three times (the same resolution Awake, OnEnable, and LateUpdate run), expecting one xr_baseline_hover_visual_unresolved warning through LogAssert.Expect plus a logMessageReceived counter, then LogAssert.NoUnexpectedReceived. In the pinned tuple the reason is the missing component; a project without XR Interaction Toolkit takes the type-not-loaded branch of the same once-per-component guard.

clauses.clause: headset tracking, grab, teleport, and comfort behavior of the generated Sandbox
missing: a Device Lab receipt bound to a full commit SHA; no package test can close this clause

summary.execution_note: RequiredFoldersAreUnderProjectRootAndUnique, ScaffoldingTwiceReusesEveryFolderAndCreatesNothingNew, ValidateReportsMissingFoldersScenesAndMarkerWithStableCodes, the three rig repair tests, UnresolvedMemberIsReportedOncePerKeyUntilReset, and MissingGrabInteractableWarnsOncePerComponent have not executed in a Unity Editor; the map records authored coverage, not results.
